reviews.text: Very happy with the experience I had at the clinic. Dr. Mesute Gok is an excellent professional. The service is one of the best I've seen in a long time. Without a doubt, they do everything to take care of the pets, sparing no effort. May God bless the whole team. Very grateful to have found you here in Cork.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to Paw Paws Vet Clinic for the exceptional care we received. The entire team was extremely kind, professional, and caring towards us and, most importantly, towards our beloved Melissa. ❤️🐾

A special thank you to Dr. Mesut Gok for his dedication, professionalism, kindness, and care throughout Melissa’s treatment. During such a difficult and worrying time for us, we found professionals who gave us reassurance, confidence, and genuine compassion.

We are also very grateful for all the attention and consideration we received during this important time in Melissa’s recovery.

We wholeheartedly recommend Paw Paws Vet Clinic. Excellent service, highly skilled professionals, and a genuine commitment to the well-being of animals.

May God bless the entire team and continue to bless the wonderful work you do! 🙏❤️🐾

Words can't describe it!! Gratitude to all of them. They are super kind and incredibly humane. Dr. Mesut was very attentive to our dog, who had to have her left eye removed due to a tick-borne disease that wasn't diagnosed in Brazil before coming here. This caused a tumor behind her eye after the glaucoma. I highly recommend them because, besides having good prices, they are super attentive. I am very satisfied with the service 🥰
Super-friendly and helpful for a pre-travel health check. Thank you.

My first experience with this clinic was very good. The doctor was friendly and helpful, and I have no complaints about the veterinary care or the prices.

Unfortunately, my experience during an emergency, while speaking to the gentleman at reception over the phone, was very different. My cat had eaten the moisture-absorbing packet from a treat bag, and I was understandably very worried. Instead of simply helping me, I felt judged and was told that this was not allowed in Ireland and that next time I should not, and I quote, “waste my time giving my cat treats.”

I understand that veterinary work can be stressful, but that is never an excuse to be rude. There is a real person on the other side of the phone, worried about their pet.

The doctors are great and the prices are good, but unfortunately, this kind of treatment matters to me, and I won’t be returning.

Edit: Your response explains why you found the call confusing, but it doesn’t address the way I was spoken to. My complaint was never about being asked questions or being told to come in. It was about the tone and the lack of empathy. I did explain that there was a little sachet inside the treat package marked “do not eat”. You asked if it was a moisture-absorbing sachet, and I said yes. You then asked if it was silica gel, and I said no,  it was a powder, a deoxidizer. I said it was not gel because it wasn’t gel. Maybe my English wasn’t clear enough for you to understand exactly what I was trying to explain, but I was genuinely doing my best in a stressful situation.
And yes! my cat is okay. We took her to another vet, she was treated, and she is now home resting.
Thank you for clarifying your side.
Excellent treatment and friendliness

5 stars simply isn't enough for the team at Paw Paws.

We've been bringing our dogs to Paw Paws for nearly two years now. We first came to them when our older dog, Maisy, was 15 years old. She had become lethargic and had slowed down significantly. I made an emergency call, and despite not being a client at the time, there was no hesitation—they booked her in immediately, treated her, and she recovered. Thanks to their care, we were lucky enough to have almost two more wonderful years with her.

Three weeks ago, we had to make another emergency call when Maisy became very limp and was swaying as she stood. Once again, Paw Paws acted immediately. She was booked in within 10 minutes, and we were at the clinic 20 minutes later. The team spent nearly two hours caring for her, giving her fluids while she relaxed on a bed looking out the window.

We brought Maisy home, and two days later she passed away peacefully in her sleep at the incredible age of 17½ years old.

The team at Paw Paws gave us the greatest gift they could have—more precious time with her. Not just those final two days, but the extra two years we were blessed with after our very first visit. They gave us the chance to say goodbye on our own terms, and Maisy was able to pass peacefully at home.

When we contacted Paw Paws about the next steps for cremation, everyone was compassionate, kind, and understanding. They treated the loss of Maisy as the loss of a cherished family member, which meant so much to us.

Last week, we received a sympathy card along with two prints of Maisy's paw prints. It was something I'd been regretting not getting at the time, and that small gesture meant more to us than I can put into words.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Mesut and every single member of the Paw Paws team for everything you've done for Maisy and for our family. Your compassion, professionalism, and genuine care will never be forgotten. We will be forever grateful.

My dog ​​Ari and I think you are the best veterinary clinic in town no matter what others say. We are truly grateful for the care and attention you have given us over the past 3 years. Paw paws vets really did a perfect job. Big love from two of us. ❤️🙏 …
Thanks for that Dominika

Thanks for taking the time Aaron.
Glad we were able to nurse the little kittens back to health. :-)

Fantastic vet close to the city centre.
Such a professional practice with a genuine care for animals.
I’m so thankful to have been met with so much compassion when bringing my sick cat in this week.
Cannot thank Ron and Dr Mesut enough for their hard work and kindness 💜

Dr. Mesut and Dr. Josh are wonderful compassionate vets, I would highly recommend them both. They went above and beyond for our Poppy recently when she became very ill, very quickly. They took time to explain everything very clearly so that we understood all the treatments. We are so grateful to them and to the rest of the Paw paws team (lovely veterinary ?nurse also) for all their care of Poppy and their amazing kindness.

If I could do zero stars I would. Anyway the manager there is rude obnoxious. I have seen the inside and the place was full of alcohol on a shelf asked me to hold my dog for them to do testing because the manager himself is all about money and won’t get any assistant or nurses for the poor vet staff. The place was not fit for standard tried giving my dog an out of date prescrition. Do not buy from the manager he thinks he knows about nutrition but has never done any training or course about animals. I thought you had to be a licensed veterinary surgeon to own a practise anyways? Do no go here and stay well clear from this dirty place
Excellent service!
Amazing work

Josh is the best vet we could have asked for our baby. I couldn't recommend anyone better. Great care even for the smallest, most fragile fur babies. The clinic overall was so patient with us. I really can't imagine going to another vet if we ever need veterinary assistance again.

How do we even begin to thank the team at Paw Paws.  Ron, Dr. Smith, Dr. Gok, you have been absolute Earth Angels.  To be truly listened to and especially Dr. Smith and Dr.  Gok, your invaluable advice has been a saving grace for our George.

I will be forever grateful for the day I walked through your practice door, desperate for help with what was then a full on stray cat, just on the brink of fully trusting us.  You all understood that his needs were different to your every day pet.

George has come grown in leaps and bounds from the cat that first made an appearance in our yard, thin, hissing and untrusting.  It took many months of time, patience and advice to the "mighty lad" he is now.  Were it not for our neighbor, I don't think anyone would have believed he had been a stray.

Anyone can study to be a vet, but Dr. Smith and Dr. Gok, they are one of a kind, our George is not "just" one of their many patients to them, they truly see him.

They take not only the needs of your beloved pet into account, but that there is a human who may also need to be listened to and their emotional needs met.

I know I have said countless thank yous, but myself and my himself will be forever grateful for what you have done not only for our George, but for his parents too.

Mesut and Josh are caring and professional, and I have no issues with them.
However, the person I believe to be the owner is incredibly rude and dismissive.
You can be left waiting at the door and spoken to in a condescending, aggressive manner.If you truly care about your pet and want to be treated with basic respect, I would strongly recommend choosing another veterinary clinic.

We have been bringing our 3 dogs here with a while and have always been very happy with the service. Ron, Mesut and all the team genuinely care and could not be nicer. Our 12 year old darling Whippet was in the final stages of heart failure and we discussed it with Mesut who advised to spend a few weeks with him and bring him back to be put to sleep. On the day of, we were treated with such compassion that it made the whole process so much easier. We were not rushed in any way and stayed with our baby for over an hour. Both Ron and Mesut were also quite emotional. I highly recommend this vets practice to anyone who loves their furbabies and want them to receive the best care possible.

We have a Basset Hound that's been suffering with a prolonged nagging skin condition the past few months. We've altered his diet and he's been to a local vet twice (in Galway) and received prescriptions of oral steroids which reduced inflammation but the vet was reluctant to prescribe them long term. After consulting the internet we learned we are not alone and this breed of dog is notorious for suffering with skin allergies. I contacted Paws Paws in Cork as I found they had stocked a special shampoo recommended by other basset hound owners online for similar skin conditions. Their staff were unbelievably knowledgeable, courteous and professional to chat with and although the problem is a lot more complex than I had initially believed, they advised me on the next steps we should take to resolve it; a process of elimination and trying different treatments until we found the most effective one as there were many. The conversation over the phone was very insightful and helpful, very grateful to the individual I spoke with over the phone for sharing his high level of expertise!
Thank you so much glad we could help Coby
The staff here are absolutely lovely. They did my kittens first vaccine and check up and were brilliant. Very informative and their pet plans are extremely affordable. Highly recommend this place!
5 stars for Musa the Vet, 0 for the Receptionist, found him quite rude, unfortunately.

This clinic is very dissatisfied with our dog's skin problems. First they treated it with medication, then they did a biopsy, it cured it for a while, but the problems keep recurring. They don't even try to make sure our pet gets better and doesn't have to go every 2 months. Very disappointed. I don't recommend this clinic to anyone.
The best place to take your pet; they're very attentive, dedicated, and kind. I've been going there for two years and have only good experiences to share. I highly recommend it.
Thanks Eleanor :-)
Very helpful staff, very knowledgeable vet. Thanks again!
Thanks for taking the time, much appreciated :-)

We’ve been bringing our energetic Border Collie, Charlie, to this clinic since she was a baby—almost 4 years now—and Paw Paw has truly become like family to us.

Charlie is a very active girl and has had her fair share of injuries, but the team has always been incredibly supportive, especially during emergencies. Dr. Mesut is dedicated, compassionate, and always goes the extra mile. Ron, the owner, has genuinely become part of her pack.

Despite all the visits over the years, Charlie absolutely loves coming here, which says so much about how gentle, caring, and kind everyone is. The bond they’ve built with her is something truly special.

We’re moving soon, but we’ll continue coming back—it’s more than worth the drive. The quality of care, the warmth of the people, and the love they show for the animals is priceless. We highly, highly recommend Paw Paw to anyone looking for a vet that truly cares.
The reason for 4 stars is, that they didn't phone me when my pet was finished recovery after surgery, and instead emailed me.
Luca always has a great experience at Paw Paws
Travelling back to the uk so had to get treatment for dog. Fabulous advice and help. Greatly recommend 👍 …
Great staff, very informative and so very kind to the animals the see. Highly recommend 👌 …
Have a good experience here for my cat’s vaccine and microchip😃 …
Very Good Service, and Vet is very friendly.

I’ve been bringing my cat, Gizmo, to PawPaws for years, and I can’t recommend Mesut enough. He’s an outstanding vet—professional, compassionate, and incredibly thorough. Mesut has taken amazing care of Gizmo over the years, and most recently, he helped prepare him for a long ferry journey from Ireland to the UK.

Thanks to Mesut, both Gizmo and I felt completely relaxed during the trip. He handled all the necessary documents, ensured Gizmo was healthy and travel-ready, and gave me peace of mind every step of the way. It’s rare to find someone who combines expertise with genuine care like he does. We will miss him so much. Thank you for everything, Mesut!

I lived in Cork for a while and always took Laquiê 🐈‍⬛ to PawPaws Clinic with Dr. Mesut for her routine check-ups, vaccines, deworming and travel preparations.

Every visit was a great experience! Dr. Mesut and the team were always super attentive, kind, and helpful. They explained everything clearly, checked if I had any questions, gave great advice for her future care, and were very accommodating whenever I needed to reschedule.

I always felt my cat was in really good hands. Highly recommend PawPaws! Such a caring and professional team!

The vet is truly a hero in every sense, combining expertise with a deep compassion and always go above and beyond to provide the best care. Honestly highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who treats their patients like family. Thank you Dr.mezut and all team

Absolutely fantastic experience at this veterinary clinic! From the moment we walked in, the team was incredibly kind, attentive, and professional. Despite the language barrier, communication was never an issue as they took the time to explain everything clearly.

We went there to get the European passport for our dogs, and they provided all the necessary information, answering every question with patience and expertise. On top of that, they treated our dogs with such warmth and care, making us feel completely at ease.

I’d highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for top-quality care and a genuinely friendly approach, both for their pets and themselves. Thanks a million for everything!

If I could give 10 stars, I would! The service at PawPaws is absolutely outstanding. Everyone there is incredibly kind and professional. They took the time to explain everything clearly, always making sure we had no doubts. Plus, they were so loving and gentle with our dogs. I’m truly grateful for their care and dedication. I 100% recommend PawPaws!

If I could give 6 out of 5 I would. I’ve been to Paw Paws multiple times and Ron is always very welcoming, giving fantastic advice and insights around caring for my Frenchie. More recently with Dr Mesut, he was able to give a thorough …

They saved my cats life, that's as best a review any veterinarian can get.

She'll likely need continued care and Paw Paws Vet Clinic is happy to provide.

Thank you so much
Quick and painless for both me and my cat! Dr. Mesut was kind and gentle and made us feel at ease. Overall, excellent service.
The best clinic! They are very kind and  patient. They give you good advice and handle your pet with care and affection. I highly recommend them!
